CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the Salesforce EmailTemplate used by the Send Email Flow when notifying a user that their progress was saved. Read via BlankValue fallback after any platform-event override. Pairs with Send Save Progress Email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the developer name of the EmailTemplate to use when emailing users that their saved progress was kept. Works together with Send Save Progress Email.
CustomField.label: Email Template Name (Saved)
